rows.ja: クラウド基盤の供給元

relations.text: AppFolioは、Amazon BedrockをRealm-Xの提供基盤の中核に使っている
relations.text_en: AppFolio uses Amazon Bedrock as a central part of how it delivers Realm-X

source.label: AppFolio の発表
source.quote: Amazon Bedrock plays a central role in how AppFolio delivers Realm-X responsibly at scale, providing the governance, safety, and compliance controls the platform requires.

relations.text: AppFolioはAWSの早期採用企業として、AWSと直接協力して製品を形づくった
relations.text_en: As an early adopter, AppFolio worked directly with AWS to shape the product

source.label: AppFolio の発表
source.quote: As an early adopter, AppFolio worked directly with AWS to shape the product to its performance standards

relations.text: AppFolioのRealm-XとAnthropicのClaudeを結ぶ、エージェント間コネクタを発表した
relations.text_en: AppFolio announced an agent-to-agent connector between its Realm-X AI suite and Anthropic's Claude

source.label: AppFolio の発表
source.quote: today announced a milestone in Real Estate Performance Management: an agent-to-agent connector between its AppFolio Realm-X AI suite and Anthropic’s Claude.

relations.text: AppFolioはAmazon Bedrock上でClaudeを利用している
relations.text_en: AppFolio uses Claude on Amazon Bedrock

source.label: AppFolio の発表
source.quote: Anthropic’s Claude is one example: AppFolio’s use of Claude on Amazon Bedrock is detailed in a published case study
